title: Paired runtime dataset: which machine meets the deadline? (FCAST-EXP-REPLAY-V4)
description:
Runtimes of 704 container executions from a campaign in which every job ran on every machine of a four-machine cloud-edge fleet (two amd64 servers and two Raspberry Pi boards) under controlled background load, at 70 chronological forecast origins over seven workload families.

The archive holds the paired dataset with its issue-time features, the outputs of the confirmatory forecasting and placement analysis, the frozen acquisition and analysis specifications, and the scripts that rebuild the tables and figures of the accompanying article, Which Machine Meets the Deadline? Runtime Forecasting for Computation Placement in the Cloud-Edge Continuum, submitted to Forecasting (MDPI). Host identifiers are pseudonymised; the README documents the change and the original checksums.
